tests.requirement: For supply connections, use wiring materials suitable for at least X°C (where X > max temperature measured in terminal box or wiring compartment under NORMAL USE), or equivalent, marked at the point of supply connections
Statement not applied to parts requiring removal to make the connection, and CLEARLY LEGIBLE after connections made
Marking of controls and instruments

Switches used to control power to ME EQUIPMENT, including mains switches, shall have their 'on' and 'off' positions marked with symbols IEC 60417-5007 and IEC 60417-5008, or indicated by adjacent indicator light, or indicated by other unambiguous means

Switches used to control power to parts of ME EQUIPMENT shall have their 'on' and 'off' positions marked with symbols as specified, or with IEC 60417-5264 and IEC 60417-5265, or indicated by adjacent indicator light, or indicated by other unambiguous means
A switch that brings the ME EQUIPMENT into the 'stand-by' condition may be indicated by use of symbol IEC 60417-5009
If a push button with bistable positions is used: shall be marked with symbol IEC 60417-5010; and status shall be indicated by adjacent indicator light or other unambiguous means
If a push button with momentary on position is used: shall be marked with symbol IEC 60417-5011; or status shall be indicated by adjacent indicator light or other unambiguous means
Different positions of control devices/switches indicated by figures, letters, or other visual means

Controls provided with an associated indicating device when change of setting of a control could result in an unacceptable RISK to PATIENT in NORMAL USE, or an indication of direction in which magnitude of the function changes
Numeric indications of parameters on ME EQUIPMENT expressed in SI units according to ISO 80000-1 except the base quantities listed in Table 1 expressed in the indicated units
ISO 80000-1 applied for application of SI units, their multiples, and certain other units
All Markings in Sub-clause 7.4 complied with tests and criteria of 7.1.2 and 7.1.3
SAFETY SIGNS
A SAFETY SIGN with established meaning used
RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS identifies markings used to convey a warning, prohibition or mandatory action that mitigate a RISK not obvious to the OPERATOR (ISO 14971 Cl. 5.2-5.5, 6, 7.2)

semantic_fragments.content: Clause 7.4.1 details requirements for power control switches on ME EQUIPMENT: mains switches and switches controlling power to ME EQUIPMENT must clearly indicate 'on' and 'off' positions via IEC symbols (5007/5008), adjacent indicator lights, or other unambiguous means. Switches for parts of equipment may additionally use IEC 60417-5264/5265. Stand-by switches may use IEC 60417-5009. Bistable push buttons must use IEC 60417-5010 with status indication. Momentary-on push buttons must use IEC 60417-5011 or equivalent status indication. All sub-clauses under 7.4.1 are marked N/A for this device.

Clause 7.5 SAFETY SIGNS requirements: The risk management process must identify markings used to convey warnings, prohibitions, or mandatory actions that mitigate risks not obvious to the operator (per ISO 14971). ISO 7010-M002 symbol is provided to indicate following the instruction for use. Safety signs must use colours per ISO 3864-1, include appropriate precautions or instructions to reduce risks, and be described in the instructions for use in a language acceptable to the intended operator. All 7.5 requirements pass (verdict P).
